reviews.text: Excellent service

Our trusted vet, we've been going to them our whole lives. They've treated all our dogs, and the service is unbeatable. The way they explain everything, the instructions, the time they dedicate to us—for me, they're the best!

Excellent service, highly recommended. They treat animals very well, especially my two kittens, who are seen by the veterinarian Richard. He's an excellent person, very kind, and explains everything very well.
The rest of the staff is also very kind, pleasant, and trustworthy. Arriving there and seeing how they treat the animals is a real pleasure. 10 out of 10, highly recommended!
I'm very happy with everyone. Thank you so much for taking care of my cats.
I am very happy with the service I received from Amapro's administration and the veterinarian. They answered all my questions. I recommend the clinic one hundred percent.
Raquel from reception attended to us very efficiently and quickly; we went there urgently with my little one and they attended to us immediately and very professionally.
Excellent hairdressing service. Thank you so much, Aunt Oseleida, for being such a good professional and so caring with my little one.
Excellent service and treatment
I always bring Kiara here and the service is a 10/10. Plus, she goes to the hairdresser here every year and they make her look fantastic.
The best vet I know, it's far from my house but I definitely go to them. The blonde girl named Camino is the kindest and answers any question right away. Without a doubt, the best, very professional.

It's truly astonishing that this clinic is certified, has inflated prices for most of its services and procedures, and can't even offer some services, supposedly because it doesn't specialize in them, when in reality it should. Sending a client elsewhere or telling them, "Come back another day, we'll give you the number of the right person," is a very strange way to help someone. If you call yourselves a veterinary clinic, please have the decency to offer all specialized services, not only to help people with their pets, but also to handle all the paperwork if necessary, and at the very least, review the cost of your services. It's unacceptable to charge exorbitant prices for a single service when other clinics can do everything at once for the same price. At the very least, make sure your reception staff can communicate effectively with clients.

Yesterday, I took my 12-year-old cat to the clinic with a urinary tract infection. I called because someone recommended them, and from the moment the receptionist answered (thank you!) to the veterinarian Amparo (who treated my cat incredibly well, as if she'd known him forever), he's much calmer and doing much better today. He's not in pain and is eating and drinking. Thank you so much for taking care of my cat so quickly. A thousand thanks. You've definitely gained another customer.

This clinic is a 10/10. The wonderful team of veterinarians are truly professional, accurate in their diagnoses, and effective in treatments, surgeries, and everything else. They are attentive and incredibly kind. I highly recommend them. I will definitely stay with them. The prices are very reasonable.

Hi Sergi,
Thank you for such a positive review! It means a lot to us to know you had a good experience. We hope to see you again soon!

Thanks again,
Avenida del Puerto Veterinary Clinic
Very friendly and everything was great
I've been going to this vet for years and I'm more delighted every time. Nacho's attention to my dog ​​was magnificent and very fast, I will continue to trust them.

Dara and I received exceptional service... without a doubt, they are top-notch professionals... I have 100% confidence in their work, and the love and care they have for the animals is truly appreciated ❤️ 100% recommended!
Thank you for your friendly and professional service. I don't know what we would do without you.

Very little empathy from the vet, Ignacio, who called my dog ​​old even though he's 13 years old. He's part of the family. Also, a woman rudely told me to leave the room because they wanted to do some blood work.
I'm never going back! I'll tell anyone who asks me about this clinic. The sad thing is, I recommended Tristan to my partner, but when we have any problems, I'd rather go to Liria and drive 40 km than take him to you.
Very professional, attentive, and empathetic with our pets. My cat just wants to go there 😸♥️ …
Excellent professionals and very humane treatment. Richard has been our veterinarian for over 10 years and is a fantastic professional and a great person. 100% recommended.
Fantastic professionals!! They solved my dog's problem after years of going to other veterinary clinics without any solution. I will be eternally grateful!

I loved the clinic! Paco is an excellent veterinarian. It gave me so much peace of mind to bring my dog ​​here; she received excellent care, and everything was explained very well. I will never go to another vet again; this will be my go-to clinic from now on. Thank you to the whole team ❤️

I took my dog ​​Tomate, a French bulldog, to the Av del Puerto Veterinary Clinic for surgery to correct cryptorchidism and respiratory problems. Dr. Paco explained everything to us from the beginning, calmly and without any strange technical jargon.

The surgery went perfectly, and the post-operative follow-up has been impeccable. It's clear he truly cares about the animals' well-being, not just making money. The clinic team was also very attentive and friendly.

Tomate has recovered wonderfully and is already back to his old self. 100% recommended. Thank you, Paco, and the whole team. ❤️❤️❤️

I've been bringing them here for years.
I must highlight Nacho's excellent service; he's a true professional.
A highly recommended clinic, excellent service and very happy with the service
Always great. I've been coming for many years and it's always been wonderful. Thanks team!

Amazing people with huge hearts. True professionals. They've treated my little one since he was born and even performed emergency surgery. Even so, he still goes in calmly, and so do we 🙂.
Our trusted vets 😻 …
I went in an emergency because I couldn't go to my usual clinic, they attended to me quickly and were very kind.
Amparo saved my dog. My go-to clinic. I will always be grateful.
Excellent service for both pets and their owners, highly professional. 100% recommended.
Excellent veterinarians, excellent clinic, always busy with clients, and their prices are very good and reasonable with financing options available.
Good professionals, many years with them
Highly professional, they always provide solutions to all problems, and the best part is the price. Excellent value for money. A highly recommended clinic.

Hello.
My five-year-old cat, Missi, was having trouble urinating because she had crystals in her urine.
After exhausting other treatments, the amazing surgical team performed a urethrostomy.
It was a delicate and precise operation.
It was a success.
The treatment of pets and their owners is impeccable, caring, and they provide lots of detailed information so you can understand exactly what's wrong and why with your pet.
Thank you 😘

I'm so happy with this clinic. It was a lifesaver for my dog's illness; they found the right treatment and she's doing wonderfully. Every time we've had a problem, they've given us excellent care and successful treatment.

And the grooming service is fantastic. Plus, all the staff are lovely.
As always, the service, attention, and solution to my dog's problem were top-notch.
They are great professionals; I've been a client of the clinic since they opened in '97. Excellent service, highly recommended.

Moving to a new city is always a challenge, and finding a trustworthy veterinarian for your pets is often one of the hardest tasks. After visiting several times with my cats, I couldn't be more certain that I chose this clinic.
My last visit was for a dental cleaning, and once again, the entire team provided excellent service. I especially want to highlight Nacho and Ana; they are incredibly dedicated professionals. What I value most is their comprehensive approach: they don't just focus on the clinical aspects, but also offer a caring, calm, and very humane treatment.
It's such a relief and a joy to know that my kitties are in the best hands. Highly recommended!
We were swayed by the good reviews. Dr. Amparo treated our Pipa with great care and professionalism, explained everything to us, and gave her a thorough evaluation. It gave us a lot of peace of mind.
